note: Things scripts/check-wiring.mjs would flag that are actually correct. An exception is an argument, not a mute: it carries the reason and a date on which the argument has to be made again. Deleting a finding instead of excusing it is how a limit outlives what caused it.

exceptions.reason: Written by a lap at the moment it stops mid-work for want of budget, and by nothing else. Writing it in advance would defeat what it is for. Its absence is not silent: compute-eta reports escape_hatch_status NEVER ARMED on the efficiency candidate, so a reader can tell 'no lap has ever hit the wall' from 'this does not apply right now'.
exceptions.recheck_asks: has any lap written it yet? If none has by then, the mechanism depends on laps remembering, and remembering is what keeps failing here — replace it with something the gate writes automatically.

exceptions.reason: Published by runs in another repository that hold the YouTube credentials; nothing here can write it. compute-eta reports the youtube channel as UNMEASURED rather than guessing, which is the correct behaviour when it is absent.
exceptions.recheck_asks: is anything actually publishing it yet? If not, YouTube has been unmeasured for two weeks and the ETA has a hole in it that nobody is filling.
